capabilities.boundary: A single event-removal verifier is not qualification for complete part removal.
Instrument identity, program/bank and target-part preservation require a separate verifier.
Part-isolated stems require qualified source binding and renderer execution evidence.
Doubling requires explicit orchestration identity and leakage-safe stem validation.
Drum removal is a multi-event/percussion-track task, not a single-note removal.
Drum replacement requires drum-kit/note identity and independent target verification.
Drum extraction requires part-isolated audio qualification and real multitrack checks.
Duration changes need exact tick/tempo-map semantics and acoustic articulation validation.
Duration changes need exact tick/tempo-map semantics and acoustic overlap validation.
Instrument and whole-mixture dynamic scopes must be qualified separately.
Instrument and whole-mixture dynamic scopes must be qualified separately.
Integer MIDI semitone transposition is not cent-level tuning correction.
